name: Spring-return qualifier
summary: A spring-return qualifier indicates return after the specified operating force is removed.
description: A spring-return qualifier indicates return after the specified operating force is removed. Removing the operating force allows the mechanism to return to its specified resting position. A centre-return selector and a returning pushbutton can share this principle while operating different contact sets.
Make the resting position explicit in the position table or legend. If several contacts are linked to the actuator, record their individual states in that resting position.
readingNotes: Show which position is the resting position and which contacts change during return.
Spring return does not define whether the resting contacts are open or closed.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.

distinction: Spring return does not define whether the resting contacts are open or closed.
